question: How many field players are in a hockey team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In field hockey, each team typically consists of **11 players: 10 outfield players and 1 goalkeeper.**
 
• However, the exact number can vary slightly depending on the specific rules of a given **league or tournament**.
 
• **Hockey** is a fast-paced sport played between two teams, traditionally of six players each: one goaltender and five players who skate up and down the ice trying to take the puck and score goals against the opposing team.
 
• There are different types of hockey including** ice hockey, field hockey, roller hockey, sledge hockey, and street hockey, among others. Here, I'll focus on ice hockey, the most globally recognized type.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ice hockey **is typically played on a rectangular rink with rounded corners.
 
• The rink is divided into three sections: **two end zones (where the goals are located) and a neutral zone in between**.
 
• The end zones contain a goal crease, a semi-circular area in front of the goal where specific rules apply.
 
• The objective of the game is to score more goals than the opposing team
 
• A goal is scored when the puck completely crosses the goal line between the posts and under the crossbar of the opposing team's goal.
